title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
description: A poor boy (Freddie Highmore) and four spoiled children win a tour through the incredible factory of an odd confectioner (Johnny Depp).

title: Spring Breakers
description: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.

title: This Is Not a War Story
description: Some veterans take part in an unusual art project designed to help them deal with the leftover trauma associated with their combat experiences.

title: Patti Cake$
description: Patricia, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back.

title: The East
description: Hired to infiltrate a group of ecoterrorists, an undercover operative (Brit Marling) instead finds herself growing sympathetic to the cause and attracted to the leader (Alexander Skarsgård).

title: Open Water
description: Scuba divers (Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis) struggle to survive in shark-infested waters after their tour boat accidentally leaves them behind.

title: Extraction
description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

title: Man Down
description: With help from his best friend (Jai Courtney), a Marine (Shia LaBeouf) embarks on a desperate search to find his wife (Kate Mara) and son (Charlie Shotwell) in post-apocalyptic America.

title: Rampage
description: When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago.

title: The Apparition
description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run.

title: The Wolfman
description: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.

title: Red Riding Hood
description: A young woman (Amanda Seyfried) begins to suspect that the werewolf terrorizing her village is someone she loves.

title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
description: A journal is discovered written by Abraham Lincoln throughout his life that reveals from the time he was a young boy, Abraham Lincoln's life was intertwined with vampires.

title: Aniara
description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

title: Grudge Match
description: A boxing promoter (Kevin Hart) offers two rival boxers (Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone) the chance to come out of retirement for one final bout.

title: Sucker Punch
description: Retreating into a fantasy world, a captive young woman (Emily Browning) finds four allies to join in a fight to escape from the terrible fate that awaits them.

title: Full Metal Jacket
description: A Marine (Matthew Modine) and his companions (Adam Baldwin, Vincent D'Onofrio) endure basic training under a sadistic drill sergeant and fight in the 1968 Tet offensive.

title: Fantastic Beasts: A Natural History
description: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals.

title: The Maltese Falcon
description: Private eye Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) encounters sundry characters (Mary Astor, Peter Lorre), all seeking a coveted statuette.

title: The Last Samurai
description: In the 1870s a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.

title: All Eyez on Me
description: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices.

title: The Daytrippers
description: Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him.

title: The Town
description: A Boston bank robber (Ben Affleck) looks for a way out of his criminal lifestyle after beginning a passionate romance with the woman (Rebecca Hall) that his gang briefly took hostage.

title: Shut In
description: Living in isolation in rural Maine, a widowed child psychologist (Naomi Watts) starts to believe that the ghost of a missing boy (Jacob Tremblay) is in her house during a dangerous ice storm.

title: The Craft
description: Teen misfits befriend a suicidal newcomer and strike back at their tormentors with witchcraft in Los Angeles.

title: The Watchers
description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
description: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman join forces with their American counterparts to battle a ruthless and common enemy.

title: Blood Father
description: An ex-convict (Mel Gibson) and his estranged daughter (Erin Moriarty) go on the run from her drug-dealing boyfriend (Diego Luna) and his vicious cartel.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: Super Troopers 2
description: Former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption in Canada. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties and a smuggling ring.

title: The Usual Suspects
description: A detective (Chazz Palminteri) questions a con man about his relationships with assorted criminals (Stephen Baldwin, Gabriel Byrne) and their link to a ship explosion.

title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
description: Harley Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask and every other thug in Gotham. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

title: Joker
description: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Joker: Folie à Deux
description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

title: The Shape of Water
description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.

title: Beirut
description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who returns to service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death.

title: Road House
description: Hired to tame a rowdy Missouri bar, a Ph.D. bouncer (Patrick Swayze) romances a doctor (Kelly Lynch) and tames the whole town.

title: Mojave
description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home.

title: My Soul to Take
description: A teen (Max Thieriot) must figure a way to save his friends from a presumed-dead serial killer who has returned to finish the job he started 16 years earlier.

title: Body at Brighton Rock
description: A part-time state park employee faces her worst fears as she guards the site of a potential crime scene deep in the wilderness.

title: Companion
description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

title: The Whistlers
description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

title: Trance
description: A criminal (Vincent Cassel) hires a hypnotherapist (Rosario Dawson) to probe the mind of a brain-injured auctioneer (James McAvoy) to uncover the hiding place of a stolen painting.

title: This Is Not a War Story
description: Some veterans take part in an unusual art project designed to help them deal with the leftover trauma associated with their combat experiences.

title: Godzilla Raids Again
description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan.

title: Godzilla vs. Biollante
description: A monster dinosaur wrecks Tokyo some more and meets a monster plant created from his own cells.

title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra.

title: Destroy All Monsters!
description: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens.
